blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) delivered an outsized half-point interest rate hike on Thursday, taking a more aggressive stance against stubbornly high inflation. The Monetary Board, the BSP’s top policymaking body, set the key rate at 5.50 percent. READ: Poll: BSP seen raising rates again Only two of 20 economists polled by the Inquirer correctly predicted the move. This followed inflation’s rise to a three-year high of 7.2 percent in September, as elevated oil prices compounded food supply disruptions from heavy monsoon rains. The BSP’s latest move brought cumulative rate hikes since April to 125 basis points. […]... Keep on reading: BSP jolts markets with jumbo rate hike
